nom: Personal Day Just Like New Adapinoid Serum

avis.titre: Personal day just like new serum
avis.texte: I like the product. I do not like how the dispenser works to get the product out of the container container. I feel like there will be wasted product and it takes a lot of work to use what is remaining in the container.

I love this product. This is the first retinoid I have been able to tolerate. It is gentle but effective. My acne has cleared up including old acne marks. My only wish is that the product came in like an airless pump as the dropper is a bit difficult to use the further down the product gets. I will continue to repurchase though!

I do enjoy this product, it's less intense than retinol. However, the packaging is awful. The dropper barely gets any product, sometime I have to dip and squeeze it three times before it gets a small amount of prodcut in it. It's also glass or some type of hard material, so I won't be able to open it up and get any extra product out, which means I'm sure lots of product will go to waste. It should be in a tub or a squeeze tube. Honestly, the packaging alone means that I won't be repurchasing. A bummer since it is a nice product.

I've struggled with stubborn hormonal acne, especially on my chin and around my cheekbones, for my whole life. I've tried plenty of products like Salicylic acid toners to get rid of the combination of white heads, black heads, and even red pustules, but after getting through my first bottle of Personal Day Adapinoid Serum I will not be going back. My skin has never had such a flat and even surface before and especially in the summer months, I can handle the dryness that is expected from this serum. I 100% reccomend giving it a try and just be consistent with it to see results.

avis.titre: good luck getting the product out
avis.texte: idek if this product works because the dropper doesn't suck up any product & you can't just pour the product out.

Four stars for the product as it's great- I see a real difference in my skin and my acne has gotten better as well as fine lines, texture, and evenness in tone. However the bottle/dropper design is awful. The product is thick and super difficult to get anything in the dropper. It honestly deters me from repurchasing. I'd recommend changing the packaging to something like the Priming Milk instead so that the product stays untouched but easier to access and apply.

I was a little skeptical at first but once I started to see a difference with consistency, it was a true difference. My skin was irritated and breaking out like never before. This helped calm my skin barrier and slowed the break out. It is also fading my acne marks. I know it will take some more time but overall it's a miracle worker!
The serum was amazing, i have a very sensitive skin, however, this product did not make my skin break out. Love ❤️

For a few months now I have been sticking to a strict morning and nightly skincare routine only using Personal Day. I use their powder face wash (perfect), soft slip priming milk (literal heaven in a bottle), and the Adapinoid Serum. I have noticed an incredible difference in my skin quality, health and overall appearance. I also use any leftover priming milk and serum product on my hands and my face and hands have never felt so soft!
helps with my acne prone skin and leaves it feeling super clean

avis.titre: The most gentle and effective Retinol on the market.
avis.texte: I have used tons of products like this and they were harsh and damaging on my skin barrier. I was a little hesitant on trying this product but because I loved other products so much, I had to give it a try and it is the best staple on my routine now.
I've been trying to clear up my hormonal acne for 15 months now and the Adapinoid serum started working IMMEDIATELY for me. It's been 3 weeks and I've had no new breakouts! 10/10 recommend!

This felt intense on my skin the first couple times I used it, but my skin didn't break out, which was surprising to me. I think this adds a great healthy to look to my skin, so I plan to buy again. I also recently started using other new products, and this seems to do well with those ones too.

Product itself is AWESOME. Great for super sensitive skin, everything else I've tried has been far too harsh on my skin. However, the packaging. While cute… it's extremely hard to get the product out after a certain amount of use. I've had to take the stopper out and shake the product out. A more fiction tube style packaging would be more functional and allow the user to use all the product instead of wasting the rest and having to buy a new one. PLEASE CHANGE THE PACKAGING!!!!

I have been dealing with hormonal acne and endometriosis for almost 5 years now. I have tried so many different skin care lines, and this is the first one that I feel is actually helping my skin! It is simple and gentle.

This serum has helped my skin so much! It has made my skin so much healthier and reduced my breakouts significantly. I use it at night usually, and will even use it as a spot treatment for pimples sometimes and they go away/ heal so much quicker. Can't recommend this enough!
the product is good, don't get me wrong. but I don't like the dropper. the product is too thick so it usually stays stuck in the dropper

avis.titre: Great product, not so great packaging
avis.texte: This product is phenomenal. It's not harsh on my skin like normal retinol products. The only downside is that sometimes I can't get product out using the dropper/bottle. I've purchased two bottles, one for my apartment and one for my parent's home when I visit. Both bottles have the same issue, I can barely get a full single drop most squeezes.
I somehow missed that this has squalane which clogs my skin so much, but gave 3 stars bc the texture & product itself is nice but if you're super clog prone then dont risk.
I love it! I have super sensitive skin so finding something that doesn't kill my barrier has been hard! Have already repurchased!!
I've been using it for about 2 months and I love it! It definitely takes some time for your skin to get used to, but once you adapt to it, its great!
Absolutely love this! My skin has been clearer since I started to use.
I feel like this has really helped my completion and I enjoy the way it feels and that I don't need a lot of product!
This product has completely transformed my skin texture. My face is so smooth and clear, I could not be happier with this product so far!!
I loved this serum but i just cannit reccomend until the packaging is fixed . The dropper doesn't work so it wouldn't really help to return amd or swap to get a new one. Very disappointing
Love the packaging and the product itself! Works well when used at night.
Took a pretty long time to ship, plus the applicator didn't work. I don't think it broke me out, which is very good, but I don't think it did much either.
This serum is gentle enough on my acne prone skin, but still clears up any breakouts I may have. I love this product!

avis.titre: My favorite in the line up so far!
avis.texte: I have been using this serum for about a week and my skin improved so much! My acne heals very slow, but this got rid of my persistant acne wounds in two days! I had some under the skin acne and it has shrunk. The serum got rid of congestion in t-zone and under my eyes. So far, I have used this product, the resurfacing peel, and recovery mask, but now I want to try the rest of the collection.
I don't see a dramatic difference in my skin but it also hasn't hurt my skin. I do not like the packaging though that's for sure.

I've been using it for a few weeks now and I can tell it's helped with some acne dark spots and redness!! If I have a bad skin picking session I slap a tiny bit on and by the morning my skin is looking clear again.
This goes on so smooth and my face is so much more clear and my dark spots are a lot better

avis.titre: Great product Trouble using the dropper
avis.texte: I love this product and it's don't wonders for my skin I just have issues with getting the product out with the dropper and usually have to tip it upside down to get the product out onto my hand

I have been struggling with sensitive skin and acne for the past two years and nothing has worked in preventing breakouts like this serum. It is gentle on the skin, leaves no burning sensation, and cleared my acne after using one bottle consistently. I am on my second and I highly recommend if you have sensitive skin!

I've only been using this product for a few weeks but am really liking it. It's more gentle than adapalene, and I've already seen improvement in texture and fading of hyperpigmentation. Will continue using to hopefully clear closed comedones and prevent sebaceous hyperplasia.

I love this product, but the dropper mechanism is not helping it. My skin loves the way this product feels and never feels sticky. It definitely helps my acne stay away. But the dropper is not consistent and you feel like you waste so much product at the end because you can't get it out. I am constantly trying to get more product out and it's impossible
This has been amazing for my sensitive skin! My skin looks so healthy since I've been using it. Repurchased already!

avis.titre: Good product, if I could get it out of the container
avis.texte: the serum is as advertised, but the packaging is very flawed. I used it twice before the eye dropper broke. I've tried all sorts of things to get the serum out, with poor results. I really wanted to like this product, but this packaging is so horrid that it's not worth the fuss and frustration.

the actual serum is fantastic. it makes my sensitive, acne prone skin so soft and cleared up my cystic acne. however, the dropper is problematic. i can't tell how much i have left either bc of the thick bottle. maybe a tube would be more ideal

avis.titre: Love the serum, hate the dropper
avis.texte: I have extremely sensitive skin, and my skin loves this product. The only con I have is that the packaging isn't great. Since its a thicker, almost moisturizer textured product I think a pump bottle would work a lot better. I returned this once thinking that I got a defective bottle, turns out it worked it just isn't ideal. I do love the product, I just am worried I won't be able to get every last drop out due to the packaging.

I agree with the other comment saying irs hard tl get the product out. That said, I found if you empty the syringe and hold the top and then dip it in and release it in the formula it pulls the product up better. I do feel like I an flying thru it. Im trying to use it to replace my retinol and do think my skin looks healthier the next morning. They should fix the pump though.

I have been using this for about a month and so far am liking it. It has not caused any irritation but I was previously on tretnion. I think it's a little early yet to see results. I do wish the company would reconsider the packaging as sometimes the dropper works and sometimes it doesn't.

Ive been using this for sbout a month 3-4 tines a week and so far love the product but the packaging is awful. The dropper doesnt work half the time and to get anything out you have to shake the bottle hard and either get too much or to little product. Please change the packaging!
So far I love the product but please change the bottle! The pump doesn't work half the time and I can barely get any product out of the bottle.

this product has been a game changer for me! You can seriously tell a difference after the first use. The packaging isn't great. Sometimes the dropper works but it is always a different size so the "one drop a night" directions don't really apply. When the dropper doesn't work, you have to shake the product out which is also an inconsistent amount. The product itself is worth the hassle though! Highly recommend and will be a repeat buy for me.
I just turned 27 and this is gentle on my skin, clears my acne, and gives retinol like benefits

Still absolutely loving this product it has worked wonders for me and i will be re purchasing one thing that does concern me though is the dropper bottle used. As we all know retinoids can be quite unstable even though this form of adapalene is more stable i would like to see an airless bottle implemented i know that may disrupt the recommended application of 2 drops but lili if you see this please consider i know there are still ways to get that same dosage of product and it would greatly increase the shelf like of this product in my opinion
I have been enjoying it and it has been really gentle on my skin. It did make me purge, but that is okay. For me, it shows that is working. Haha. I also use it three times a week. :)
Ngl, my skin was dull and was more acne prone before I started using this serum every day. It has cleared my skin and it looks bright, refreshed, and moisturized. LOVE this product.
This serum leaves my skin so soft and moisturized. A little definitely goes a long way.

I've been using this for 2 weeks now and have noticed a big positive difference in my skin. I've had no irritation at all which has made it easy to incorporate it in to my existing routine. Would definitely recommend!
I have super sensitive skin and have been wanting to add more skincare items to my routine as I get older and this has been great!

I switch from prescription tretinoin to this and this is so much gentler but seems to still work well. Overall very happy with Personal Day's products. My skin has not been dry or flaky at all since switching to only using their products.
I am really enjoying this serum! I like the ingredients and that they're great for sensitive skin. The smell and feel are enjoyable as well. I'm new to these products but I'm likely to try more!

I seriously cannot get over how sensitive skin friendly this brand is! I was worried about using this product because it's a bit more intense than the other ones however, I am very very happy with the results on my skin! It has helped the texture of my skin and overall appearance!
A combination of this and the salicylic acid treatment got me through a rough month of hard cyst & nodules. It only took two weeks for me to notice a difference.
Does exactly what it claims to! Very gentle and I have not had any irritation or acne due to this.

I recently started incorporating the adapinoid serum into my routine and have noticed such a big difference in my skin. My hyperpigmentation spots have started fading and my skin looks so much more even and smooth. I've even noticed some of forehead creases being not as visible as before. I also really love that its really gentle on my skin. Usually my skin is so sensitive so introducing new products is really a gamble for me, but my skin has taken really well to this new product and I have not had any dryness or irritation. Would definitely recommend. I even had a coworker of mine mention how much better my skin has looked recently and asking for my routine!
I noticed changes while using it consistently for a week, it is very gentle and doesn't leave the skin dry

Let me tell you if there is a product that has comedogenic ingredients or concentrations of ingredients in it, it will make me break out every time and this one does not great formulation one of the few adapinoid serums on the market with a effective .5 percent adapinoid cannot rave enough about this good on you lili don't ever discontinue!!!

So far this product is great! I'm loving it. But I feel like I went through it so fast. I think the bottle is too small. Or maybe the product is too hard to get out of the bottle once it gets lower? I'm not sure. It's great otherwise though!
You see results the next morning yet it doesn't sting or burn when you use it. I love it. 10/10 I love it. Give me a supersized bottle!!

I've been looking for a gentle retinol type product for a while and this is it!! It's been fading leftover PIE like nothing else. Please never discontinue!! I also had initial problems with the dropper but now it is working well. The trick is to push the air out before putting it into the product.

I have noticed such a difference in my skin's texture since I started using this product and I love it! The texture is lightweight, it absorbs quickly, and it actually works! My acne is calmer, my dark spots are fading, and my skin barrier feels protected instead of irritated. It feels like my skin is finally healing and I'm so grateful for this product!

I love this product! I'm very sensitive to retinols and this one has been incorporated into my nightly routine with no issues! But the packaging is not working out for me! Almost immediately the dropper stopped working and I could not suction any product up with it. I'm still able to use the product by shaking it out with some struggle.
This is the best serum. It has really helped with my dark spots. I cant recommend something more.

I've been using this for several weeks and have had no skin irritation and feel like I overall have been breaking out less! The texture is very nice and it spreads super easily which is good since you use so little. I will definitely repurchase!
I have sensitive skin so a lot of products like tretinoin just irritate my skin but this was so gentle! Changed my skin!
I have very sensitive skin and this works wonders. So great to have a gentle alternative to retinol.
I love this product. I've been using this for over three weeks. My skin feels smoother. I will definitely be keeping this in my skin time routine.
I have been using this for 3 weeks at night time. And my hyperpigmentation under my neck, has gotten so better. I still have some ways to go, but I am so happy with the look of it now.

For the last 8-9 months I have been struggling with my acne and the dark acne scars it leaves on my face. I have tried everything from renewing old prescriptions from other brands that tailor your acne treatment to your skin type but none of them worked. I finally came across this product and I decided to try it, especially because my skin is extremely sensitive. Not only has this serum made my dark acne scars slowly start to fade, but my acne has cleared up almost completely. I also did not have a reaction to it like I have with other products so I practically cried when I noticed it. This came out at a great time and I signed up for the subscription because I KNOW I have FINALLY found something that works for me!

avis.titre: Where has this been all my adult life?
avis.texte: Retinoids have always wrecked my skin barrier and I have never been able to use them frequently enough to see any progress. So this serum is an ABSOLUTE GAME CHANGER. My skin is glowing, clear, and hydrated. Dark spots that have been so stubborn are visibly better every week. My skin hasn't looked this good... Ever?? Can't recommend this highly enough.
